title: Concept Vector Extraction Toolkit with Safety-Concept Templates

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Accessibility is a real bottleneck. A toolkit that makes the method easy to use would multiply adoption by safety teams worldwide. Clear chain from tool availability to broader safety practice.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a Python package requires software engineering skills but not deep ML research. Wrapping an existing pipeline and adding templates is structured work. CS students can handle this with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: A production Python package with 10 safety concept templates, one-function API, documentation, and testing is substantial. 10 concept templates each require contrastive pair design. Too broad for 30 hours.
